summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of Deepak Sapra, CEO of API and Services and Senior Management Personnel, effective November 12, 2026. Sapra resigned to pursue outside opportunities. The filing, submitted under SEBI Listing Regulations, includes the resignation letter and details. No successor is announced. This is an abrupt senior management departure, not a routine meeting notice, warranting classification as a special situation. What to watch: announcement of replacement and potential strategy impact on API division.
